title: nasturtium glastifolium
intro: Nasturtium glastifolium, commonly known as Indian Cress or Garden Cress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is rich in nutrients and has been used to support various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its high content of vitamins and antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of Nasturtium glastifolium include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
